tool_args.old_string: Our taxonomy uses \emph{ambiguity} as a policy specification umbrella term encompassing two epistemologically distinct operations. Five types involve \emph{interpretation selection}: the text admits multiple readings and the agent commits to one. Incompleteness involves \emph{information addition}: the text lacks necessary content entirely, and the agent confabulates it.
